Shaggy, shoulder-length jet black hair with messy bangs and cat ears poking through. Narrow, sharp-looking golden yellow eyes. Apparent age of a young teenager with a petite and slender build. Wears a loose, oversized white and blue school blazer over a light blue pleated skirt. Signature details include a long, thin black cat tail and a small white bell tied to a red ribbon around the neck.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
